Cure deadline is November 5 at 6 pm Eastern. Sent Items verifies an inquiry to Jake at LIMN yesterday at 7:13 am Eastern; no newer reply in reviewed inbox. Send internally: Please match the IPFS installment to our payment records today and confirm whether Jake has verified the balance and active coverage before we make any payment.

ACT NOW 3: Protect Oreka sample deadline. SenoCellTec confirmation shows November 3 while Nadia’s Canada window ends November 1. Sent Items verifies Mibelle expedite/date/payment-application inquiry sent yesterday at 7:13 am Eastern; no fresh supplier reply reviewed. Michael’s October 23 request is 2 days old and Nadia task due October 14 is 11 days overdue. Send internally: Michael and Evelyn, the Mibelle expedite request is already sent but the November 3 date still conflicts with Nadia’s November 1 Canada window; please confirm a feasible sample plan today.
